doc: Construction method switch. One master switch per box (NOT separate geometry), plus front-geometry model.
source: Mozaik Const / ConstW / ConstT (p17-18, p39 appliance pos, p60 toe)

methods.name: Frameless
methods.fr: EU box; shelf boring + hardware holes bored independently

methods.name: 32mm
methods.fr: frameless + System 32 holes used for hinges & guides; hinge/drawer sizes auto-align to grid

methods.name: Full Overlay
methods.fr: face frame but European-look full-cover fronts (reveal params)

methods.name: Frame Inset
methods.fr: face frame, fronts inset flush with frame, auto inset amount

methods.name: Frameless Inset
methods.fr: frameless, fronts inset flush with case front

front_geometry.so: OVERLAY / HALF-OVERLAY / INSET + gaps. Cabinetry software fails here most often.
front_geometry.equal_fronts_rule: available_front_height = opening_height - total_required_gaps; then divide by front_count

types.name: MDF profiled door
types.note: machined MDF, outside profile + centre raise (5-piece look from one sheet)

types.name: 5-piece / shaker (stile & rail)
types.note: Conestoga / Thermwood, rail + stiles + center panel; arches/cathedrals

carcase_rails.note: Frameless cabinet = back + base + two ends + TWO rails (front + back rail to fix bench top; front rail turned ON EDGE for sink/hob) - LMFKB3005A p54
